source.rule: The Prelife.MID wildcard * is allowed for a top-level PLID referenced from SystemDeployment or StockAllocation, while sub-materiel prelife uses a concrete MID.

hypothesis_before_native.explicit-mid: The concrete MID assigns ages60/100/120 to the three systems and first CAL100 PMs at h40/h100/h80.
hypothesis_before_native.wildcard-mid: For this single top-level system type, MID=* should assign the same ages and first PM times, with no new converter diagnostics.

predeclared_native_acceptance: Both arms exactly roundtrip 20 populated authored tables, convert with zero errors/notes and only inherited warnings #108/#126, calculate without runtime errors, seal source/raw evidence and preserve GUI PID13340 and registry option NO. Any wildcard-specific warning stops acceptance for review.
The pair differs only in Prelife.MID TEACH-AIR-01 versus literal * and description; deployment PLID, PrelifeData, PM, profile and all other model tables remain identical.
Both native Prelife Logs assign actual TEACH-AIR-01 systems ages60/100/120. First CAL100 PMs occur ID0 h40, ID2 h80, ID1 h100 with one-hour completions and no h0 PM; no missions instantiate.

Both arms have 208 contiguous half-hour System/Stock bins, terminal three ready systems, no resource or stock demand, and equivalent non-description report tables. Byte equality of raw logs is an observation.
A separate reviewer independently replays frozen source and raw evidence without importing author validation code.
limits: One top-level system MID, one deployment PLID, CALHOURS ages60/100/120, one seed and first PM only. Wildcard matching across multiple MIDs is untested.
StockAllocation wildcard, sub-prelife invalidity, installed or stocked item prelife, GUI visual behavior and cross-engine parity are unverified.
